name: tihin-admin-panel
description: TiHin Catalog Admin Panel for CSV ingest, draft review, and publishing

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const url=process.env.SUPABASE_URL||''; const key=process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY||''; fs.writeFileSync('admin-panel/config.js', 'window.__ENV__ = { SUPABASE_URL: ' + JSON.stringify(url) + ', SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ' + JSON.stringify(key) + ' };'); console.log('Generated admin-panel/config.js');"
